Text: {{c1::Bariatrics::medical specialty}} is the branch of medicine concerned with {{c2::the management of obesity}} and allied diseases.
Back Extra:
Parts: Greek baros (weight) + iatreia (medical treatment) — the medicine of weight.

Meaning: management here spans both prevention and control.

Why: the greater the degree of obesity, the more frequent and severe the health problems — so the larger the patient, the more likely he or she will need emergency treatment and transport.
